SW: the CHEST, HIPS and FEET turn WITH the head to the same three-quarter facing toward the screen's lower-left — no near-frontal ribcage under a turned head; his LEFT side (horn, tome) nearer the camera, the ribcage relief seen obliquely; keep the standing rest, the head level, two hands, the sides.
W: the CHEST, HIPS and FEET turn WITH the head into a TRUE LEFT PROFILE toward screen-left — the ribcage relief is seen edge-on from the side (not a broad frontal ribcage), the near boot points screen-left; keep the standing rest, the head level, two hands, the blade behind the far shoulder.
SE: the CHEST, HIPS and FEET turn WITH the head to the same three-quarter facing toward the screen's lower-right — no near-frontal ribcage under a turned head; his RIGHT side (blade) nearer the camera, the horn on the far shoulder; keep the standing rest, the head level, two hands.
NW: the book at his left hip carries ONLY the silver corner caps and the short red ribbon — REMOVE the two bulky silver clasp-like brackets on its outer edge; keep everything else.
